def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if false || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      end
      height = height_str

        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]

  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  return [nil, nil]
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if true
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return []
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || self.empty?

    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if self.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?(nil)
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if "xx"
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if false
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str.at(...(idx + 1))
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str.fetch(...(idx + 1))
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = dim_str.key?(...(idx + 1))
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?

      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[nil]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + nil)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(nil + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str.at((idx + 2)..)
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = self[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(nil + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str.fetch((idx + 2)..)
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str.key?((idx + 2)..)
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str

      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?

      end
      [width, height]
    else

    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(nil)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 167)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 1)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if true
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    if height

    [width, height]

      end

      end
      [width, height]
    else

    end
  end

      end
      height = height_str

      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [nil, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.any?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if false
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) && dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

    if height.empty?

      end
      [width, height]

      [dim_str, nil]

      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/nomatch\A/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || false
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?

      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil

    [width, height]

    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || "x"

      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.end_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
    width = width_str
    if width.empty?
      width = nil
    end
    height = height_str
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

      end
      [width, height]
    else

    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split(2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    if height.empty?
      height = nil

    [width, height]

    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      end
      height = height_str

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = nil
      if width.empty?

      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 167)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if true
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if true
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      height = nil
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      nil
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    unless dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = dim_str[...(idx + 1)]
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str.match?(/x\d|(?<![a-z])x\z/) || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      (width_str, height_str) = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = width_str
      if width.empty?
        width = nil
      end
      height = height_str
      if height.empty?
        height = nil
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [nil]
    end
  end
end
